---
title: "Command reference"
---

This page is generated from the command registry, like `/help` in the console.

## Console commands

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import html

from onthesignal.cli import commands as c

rows = ["| Command | Description |", "|---|---|"]
for s in sorted(c.SLASH.values(), key=lambda s: (s.category, s.name)):
    usage = html.escape(s.usage).replace("|", "&#124;").replace("-", "&#45;")
    rows.append(f"| <code>{usage}</code> | {s.description} |")
print("\n".join(rows))
```

## Analyses

Each analysis is available as `/name S1 key=value...` and as the Python function
`name(S1, key=value...)`. Without parameters, the `/` command opens a form.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from onthesignal.core.registry import commands

for cmd in sorted(commands(), key=lambda c: (c.category, c.name)):
    args = ", ".join("S" if cmd.n_signals == 1 else f"S{i + 1}" for i in range(cmd.n_signals))
    print(f"### `{cmd.name}({args}, ...)`\n\n{cmd.description}.\n")
    print("| Parameter | Default | Unit | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|")
    for p in cmd.params:
        adv = " *(advanced)*" if p.advanced else ""
        print(f"| `{p.name}` | `{p.describe_default()}` | {p.unit} | {p.help}{adv} |")
    print()
```

## Other Python functions

| Function | Role |
|---|---|
| `load(path, ...)` | load a file into the session |
| `list_sig()`, `list_res()` | list signals, results |
| `show(S)` / `S.show()` | plot a time series |
| `rename_sig(old, new)`, `rm_sig(name)` | manage signals |
| `report(results, title=..., render=True)` | Quarto report |
| `run_script(name, S1, ...)`, `batch(target, files, out=...)` | scripts and batches |
| `acquire(...)`, `realtime(...)` | SeedLink acquisition and live analysis |
